name: Eifukucho
tagline: Shibuya in 15 minutes and Shinjuku in 18 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Suginami City, where Keio run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 44.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.5 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 44.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 35.6 m to 44.1 m, a difference of 8.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 生活クラブ館 杉並

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 13 clinics and 15 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 樺島会樺島病院, about 15 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 樺島病院, about 16 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keio Inokashira Line.
congestion: Keio Inokashira Line runs at 125% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池ノ上→駒場東大前, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Eifukucho. It is served by the same lines as Eifukucho. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On safety, Nishi-Eifuku comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Meidaimae is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Eifukucho is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Eifukucho in a straight line. Meidaimae also has the Keio Line, which Eifukucho does not. With more lines, Meidaimae is the better connected of the two. To Tokyo, for instance, Meidaimae is 8 minutes quicker. On safety, though, Eifukucho comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 井ノ頭通り (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Keio Inokashira Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
